notes: CHK-013 tracks pending requests per a_source (count plus stored opcode/size of the oldest entry). If several requests with the same source are outstanding at once, only the first one's opcode/size is kept, so those cases are only approximately checked. The same-edge A and D handshake cannot match each other, because the helper state is updated after the assertion samples it. The disable flag includes the A handshake edge with i_a_intg_flip=1 and clears on rst_ni=0. I did not compile this in Verilator.
